standard-dialogue.npc: Hello. I can convert items to banknotes, for 50 coins per item. Just hand me the items you'd like me to convert.

steps.npc: I'm Piles. I lived in Draynor Village when I was young, where I saw three men working in the market, converting items to banknotes.
Their names were Niles, Miles and Giles. I'm trying to be like them, so I've changed my name and started this business here.

treasure-trails-master.text: a torn part of a clue scroll
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
